name: MBSB
recent: MBSB Bank 与 WIH Malaysia 签署 RM1bil 融资协议，用于 Gua Musang 水泥厂；同时与 Wise 扩大海外转账服务，每日限额 RM150,000。公司宣布 2026 财年首次中期股息每股 0.86 仙，除息日为 9 月 9 日。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）净利环比增长 46.7%，但同比仍下降 53.7%。
notable: MBSB Bank 与 WIH Malaysia 签署 RM1bil 融资协议，用于 Gua Musang 水泥厂。
MBSB Bank 与 Wise 扩大海外转账服务，每日限额提高至 RM150,000。
宣布 2026 财年首次中期股息每股 0.86 仙。
risks: 最新季度净利同比大幅下降 53.7%。
最新季度营收同比下降 17.2%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 351.704 million，环比增长 5.3%，同比下降 17.2%；净利为 MYR 44.222 million，环比增长 46.7%，同比下降 53.7%；净利率为 12.6%，高于上一季度的 9.0%。

recent_en: MBSB Bank signed a RM1bil financing deal with WIH Malaysia for a Gua Musang cement plant, and expanded overseas transfer services with Wise with a daily limit of RM150,000. The company declared a first interim dividend of 0.86 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 9 September. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) net profit rose 46.7% QoQ but fell 53.7% YoY.
notable_en: MBSB Bank signed a RM1bil financing deal with WIH Malaysia for a Gua Musang cement plant.
MBSB Bank expanded overseas transfer service with Wise, raising daily limit to RM150,000.
Declared first interim dividend of 0.86 sen per share for FY2026.
risks_en: Latest quarter net profit fell significantly by 53.7% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 351.704 million, up 5.3% QoQ but down 17.2% YoY; net profit was MYR 44.222 million, up 46.7% QoQ but down 53.7% YoY; net margin was 12.6%, higher than 9.0% in the previous quarter.
